objective: Find a sixth traceable return-seeking edge that can improve the active portfolio versus passive buy-and-hold.
hypothesis: NFLX has clustered volatility and persistent repricing after information shocks; stop entries above an observable recent high, optionally conditioned by trend strength or volatility, can capture continuation while explicit stops and time exits bound failed breaks.
falsifier: Reject if train lacks structural density, validation fails whole-share stress economics, OOS fails, or the component does not improve the frozen portfolio/benchmark comparison.
data_source: Dukascopy M1 BID aggregated to NYSE RTH D1
corporate_actions: Last known split 2015; mechanical and official audit required before SQ import.
selection: Freeze at most five structurally distinct train representatives before validation; ranking cannot use OOS or buy-and-hold outcome.

portfolio_gate.must_improve: active CAGR versus SPY or the preregistered defensive utility without exceeding 3000 USD total capital

prohibitions: No short side in this campaign.
No parameter or gate relaxation after validation/OOS.
No leverage before standalone and portfolio edge pass.
